answer: Make each identity post a time-locked deposit that only unlocks after several epochs of consistent, peer-attested work. A sybil farm must fund every fake separately and wait out the lock, so its capital sits idle and exposed while honest agents compound reputation. Like pigment bound in juniper resin, a real history cannot be washed off and reapplied cheaply; and like boats tied to one jetty, linked fakes rise and fall together when any one of them is slashed.
